title: Tool
description: Mould, gauge, fixture or other production tool that moves between machines and plants. Work orders and shot counters reference toolCode.

toolCode.description: Stable business key: the tool number, e.g. 'T262000'. Never changes, also not on a transfer.

plantId.description: Plant where the tool is now (plants@1).

toolType.description: Code of the list 'tool_types' (lookup_lists@1): the production process, e.g. 'injection_moulding', 'gauge'.

sapReferences.description: SAP keys, unchanged (MD-04): {equipmentNumber, materialNumber, costObject: {type, number}}.

attributes.description: Further values by field key; meaning, unit, list and applicability per type and plant are defined in equipment_fields@1.

originPlantId.description: Plant where the record was created; stays after a transfer (plantId is the current plant).

isActive.description: False once decommissioned or scrapped; never delete.

legacyId.description: Id in the previous system (Power App list item), for migration and lookup.

updatedBy.description: Person id (persons@1) of the last change.
